{{Quote|I am ''not'' one of ''you!'' I am ''Sith!''<nowiki />|Darth Azard, to a Quarren Councilor|<ref name="leg22" />}}
'''Darth Azard''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[One Sith]], serving under [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] and his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. By [[137 ABY]], he had been selected to oversee the Imperial [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]], which was tasked with capturing [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Core Fleet]] [[Gar Stazi]]. He executed [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Admiral [[Sha Dun]], who was commanding the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], for failing in his objective, and replaced him with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Admiral [[Dru Valan]].

In response to the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] aiding Gar Stazi in the capture of the new [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], Darth Krayt traveled to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] with a number of Sith Lords, including Darth Azard, to exact his revenge. Azard participated in the [[Massacre of New Coral City|massacre]] of the [[Mon Calamari Council]], where he killed many of his fellow Quarren. In the aftermath of the massacre, Azard pursued the escaping members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] who had been involved in the plan to capture the ''Imperious''. The Rogues were being rescued by [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]], who were on a mission for [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] [[Roan Fel]]. Azard [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] [[Master]] Treis Sinde, which distracted the Quarren long enough for the members of Rogue Squadron and Sigel Dare to escape.

Despite his failure to stop the Rogues' escape, Azard was appointed to oversee the [[Genocide on Dac|extermination]] of the Mon Calamari people. With the aid of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]], he awoke a [[Sea Leviathan]] in the depths of Dac. A semi-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] bio-weapon created via [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], the [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]] had been adapted to undersea use. Azard and Isen sent the Leviathan to exterminate the Mon Calamari refugees who were hiding and by doing so draw out the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] led by Treis Sinde, who had been fighting against the Sith. Azard and Isen followed the Leviathan as it led the way to the base of the Mon Calamari Rangers. During the ensuing [[Battle of Devil's Crevasse|battle]], the Sith's [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport]] was crippled, and the Leviathan was defeated by hordes of [[devilsquid]], under Treis Sinde's command.

[[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], the [[voice]] of Darth Krayt, later ordered the execution of the [[Final Protocol]], a plan that saw the oceans of Dac poisoned and all of the inhabitants executed within a week, with Azard and Isen in charge of implementing the plan. The Final Protocol resulted in the death of much of the planet's population, with only twenty percent saved in the Galactic Alliance [[Evacuation of Dac|rescue efforts]]. Later, Azard and Isen led the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]] to [[Napdu]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Da Soocha]], where the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]] was believed to have been harboring Mon Calamari refugees. Azard ordered the same toxin that poisoned Dac be unleashed on Da Soocha, followed by the bombardment of Napdu. After their success at Napdu, Azard and Isen proceeded to the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], planning to kill the natives for providing aid to the Galactic Alliance. However, just as Isen perfected his toxin for the planet, the two Sith were attacked by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]]. Azard was killed by the Jedi Master when the Sith Lord felt Darth Krayt call out to all Sith across the galaxy, distracting him long enough for Sazen to strike him down.

==Biography==
===The Third Fleet===
{{Quote|Admiral Sha Dun, you were charged by our Master, His Majesty Darth Krayt, with ending the attacks by the renegade Gar Stazi. But Gar Stazi still lives.|Darth Azard, before executing Admiral Sha Dun|<ref name="leg20" />}}
[[File:Darth_Azard.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Azard aboard the [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']].]]
The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Azard was a member of the [[One Sith]], serving [[Darth Krayt]] and his [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]], after Krayt [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] at the end of the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Azard was selected to oversee the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]]. In [[137 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Outer Rim Third Fleet was charged with capturing the fugitive [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Core Fleet]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], as well as destroying the unified fragments of the Alliance military, dubbed the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Krayt had placed [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Admiral [[Sha Dun]] in charge of the mission, and despite minor victories, Dun had failed to stop Gar Stazi's attacks. On the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command deck]] of the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']], Lord Azard executed Admiral Dun for that failure;<ref name="leg20" /> he<ref name="leg22" /> [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifted]] and choked the Kel Dor with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] before [[Death/Legends|cutting]] the admiral down with his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Azard then replaced Dun with the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] Admiral [[Dru Valan]], who had faced Stazi seven years before in the [[Battle of Caamas]], the last major battle between the [[Fel Empire|new Galactic Empire]] and the Galactic Alliance in the Sith-Imperial War. During the Battle of Caamas, Stazi had led a fighting retreat while the rest of the Alliance forces had surrendered, and Valan had been blamed for Stazi's escape. Azard told Valan not to underestimate Stazi as Sha Dun had, and warned the admiral not to fail him.<ref name="leg20" />

Admiral Valan attempted to bait a trap for Stazi using the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], which was under construction at the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards|shipyards]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]];<ref name="leg20" /> however, Stazi had prepared [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|his own trap]] with the aid of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. The battle resulted in the Alliance capturing the ''Imperious'', destroying a third of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], and devastating Valan's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Disgraced, Valan gave command to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoge]] and retired to his quarters to commit suicide rather than face Darth Azard.<ref name="leg21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>

===Massacre of Mon Calamari===
{{Quote|My Lord! No! The Mon Calamari are ''not'' our species, and I am not overly ''fond'' of them, but they do not deserve ''this''!|A Quarren Councilor pleads with Azard, in vain|<ref name="leg22" />}}
[[File:MassacreonDac.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Darth Azard cuts down a Quarren member of the Mon Calamari Council.]]
After the defeat of the Imperials at the Battle of Mon Calamari, Darth Krayt wanted retribution against the Mon Calamari for their betrayal in supporting Gar Stazi. The Emperor traveled to Dac with a number of Sith Lords, including Darth Azard, to exact his revenge. Meeting with the [[Mon Calamari Council]], Krayt presented the recently captured former Galactic Alliance [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvir]] [[Gial Gahan]], explaining that he had long known that the Mon Calamari had been secretly supporting Stazi and that he had had enough. As punishment for their actions, Krayt ordered the [[Genocide on Dac|execution]] of ten percent of the Mon Calamari population of Dac&mdash;starting with the members of the Mon Calamari Council&mdash;and the placement of Dac's remaining citizens in internment camps. As soon as Krayt gave the order, Darth Azard, the other Sith Lords, and Krayt's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] began to [[Massacre of New Coral City|execute]] all of the Mon Calamari present. Many of the Quarren members of Mon Calamari Council who opposed or questioned the Emperor's will were also executed.<ref name="leg22" />

One of the Quarren members pleaded with Darth Azard, stating that although the Mon Calamari were not one of their people, they did not deserve to be slaughtered. Darth Azard replied to the Quarren that he was not one of their people&mdash;he was a Sith&mdash;and cut the other Quarren down with his lightsaber. With the massacre underway, Darth Krayt personally executed Gial Gahan.<ref name="leg22" />

As a result of the massacre and the beginning of Krayt's genocide, the Mon Calamari began a resistance movement. To encourage a possible alliance with the Galactic Alliance Remnant, [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] Roan Fel ordered [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]] to warn Admiral Gar Stazi about the explosives they had placed within the stolen Star Destroyer ''Imperious'' while unaware of Stazi's plan. The two Knights contacted [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilot [[Monia Gahan]] and helped her fellow Rogues escape from prison by [[Mind trick/Legends|influencing]] the mind of the Imperial guarding Darth Azard's [[Darth Azard's Nune-class shuttle|personal shuttle]] to commandeer the [[Shuttle/Legends|vessel]].<ref name="leg22" />

===Duel with a Knight===
{{Quote|Jedi! No&mdash;one of Fel's Forcelings. Pity. I'd hoped for a ''match''.|Darth Azard, to Imperial Knight Treis Sinde|<ref name="leg22" />}}
[[File:DuelOnDac.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Darth Azard duels Imperial Knight Treis Sinde.]]
Darth Azard [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] and tracked it back to his shuttle. The Imperial officer standing outside informed Azard that the Alliance prisoners had boarded per the Sith Lord's orders. Realizing the officer had been a "weak-minded fool" that got mind-tricked, Azard killed the officer and rushed to his shuttle.<ref name="leg22" />

In order to buy time for their escape, Imperial Knight Treis Sinde jumped out of the shuttle to engage the Sith Lord. The two [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]], with Azard using only a single blade of his lightsaber. Azard was disappointed that he was dueling an Imperial Knight instead of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], believing an Imperial Knight would be no match for him. When several stormtroopers tried to intervene and bring down Sinde, Azard dismissed them and ordered them to focus on the shuttle instead. Sinde, however, Force pushed all of the stormtroopers, impressing Azard. As they dueled, Azard stated that Sinde would not be able to defeat him and that they both knew it. He was also aware that Sinde was trying to delay him long enough to allow the shuttle to leave. Azard assured Sinde that he had enough time to kill him and destroy his friends, however the duel was abruptly ended by a well-timed explosion set off by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire from the shuttle. The explosion allowed Sinde to escape, and Azard was forced to [[Force barrier/Legends|protect himself]] from both the explosion and a fall with the Force. Azard was furious that he had failed to stop the escape of the Imperial Knights and the Rogues.<ref name="leg22" />

===Sea Leviathan===
{{Quote|Lord Krayt's commands were clear. For now, only Mon Calamari die.|Darth Azard, to Vul Isen|<ref name="leg32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref>}}
[[File:Invoke.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Darth Azard and Vul Isen summon the Sea Leviathan.]]
Despite his failure to stop the Rogues escape, Darth Azard was appointed to oversee the extermination of the Mon Calamari people. [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] Sith [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] was sent to aid Azard in his task and speed the extermination along. The [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] had provided Isen with the knowledge necessary to create a [[Sea Leviathan]], a semi-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] bio-weapon which was the product of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. After adapting it to undersea use, Isen and Azard invoked the Force to awaken the monster, which was hibernating in the depths of [[Soheras Trench]]. The Leviathan rose from the depths and attacked the Mon Calamari being held in the [[Imperial Extermination Camp 28]], absorbing their life energy and sentience, leaving nothing but empty husks. By absorbing the Mon Calamari's sentience, the [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]] would start to think like a Mon Calamari, enabling it to better locate their hiding places. Azard was concerned that the Leviathan might start to think too much like a Mon Calamari, and attack the Imperials, however Isen assured him that it would not. Azard and Isen sent the Leviathan to exterminate the Mon Calamari refugees who were in hiding, believing it would draw out the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] led by Imperial Knight Treis Sinde, who had [[Skirmish on Dac|attacked]] the ''[[Sea Lion]]'', an [[Acklay-class mobile fortress|''Acklay''-class mobile fortress]] which had been tracking the refugees. Azard believed that by doing so, they could wipe out the Rangers all at once, a plan which impressed Isen.<ref name="leg32" />

Azard and Isen followed the Leviathan in their [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport]], and soon encountered two Mon Calamari rangers piloting underwater [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana fighters]]. The Mon Calamari tried to evade the creature, but the Sith transport managed to damage one which had escaped the Leviathan's reach. The creature proceeded to absorb the life energies of the damaged fighter's [[Adriphar|occupant]], but one Krakana managed to escape, and [[Shonmai|its pilot]] sped back to her comrades in the rangers' base. Isen allowed the Mon Calamari to escape so that she could inform the Rangers of the Imperials' impending attack, which would lead the Rangers to swarm out to meet them, rather than the Imperials having to search them out. The Givin remarked that he would be glad when the extermination was complete, as he preferred breaking a population's will. Azard believed that Lord Krayt's commands were all that a true Sith required and made as much clear to Isen. He also expressed his contempt for any Sith who was not a Darth, commenting that Isen questioned too much.<ref name="leg33">[[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]]</ref>

===Defeat===
{{Quote|You will see, lieutenant. Valuing life&mdash;even your own&mdash;is a weakness. ''I'' am not weak.|Darth Azard, to one of the shuttle's crew|<ref name="leg33" />}}
[[File:Azardcommand2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Azard overseeing the battle in the Devil's Crevasse.]]
The two Sith continued to follow the Leviathan as it led the way toward the rangers' base. During the long journey, Isen became impatient, regularly asking Azard whether they had arrived at their destination, which agitated the Sith Lord. When they finally reached the base, swarms of Krakana came out to meet them. The Mon Calamari had developed a plan; they avoided the Leviathan, and instead targeted the shuttle, hoping that by doing so they could stop the Leviathan. Isen believed this tactic was foolish, as the Krakana's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] weapons could not penetrate the shuttle's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], and the Krakana&mdash;built for speed as they were&mdash;had no missiles or shielding of their own.<ref name="leg33" />

Azard ordered the crew to kill all the Mon Calamari, and the transport's weapons opened up, spraying blaster fire in all directions. The rangers were undeterred, however; even as the Leviathan continued its pursuit of the escaping refugees, they continued to attack the transport, searching for chink in its armor. Things turned against the Sith, however, when Azard's adversary, Treis Sinde, entered the [[Battle of Devil's Crevasse|battle]] with a large group of [[devilsquid]]s. Under Sinde's command, the squids swarmed around the Leviathan, attacking it. In response, Azard ordered the deployment of the transport's [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark fighters]] to deal with the Krakana, while the transport would kill the devilsquids. Though the shields had to be lowered to launch the Sharks, Azard was confident that by concentrating fire on the area of the launch, they would be able to clear out the Krakana. Azard believed the Mon Calamari were not aggressive and they valued life too much, something he considered a weakness. This assumption was proven wrong moments later, as a lone Mon Calamari ranger made a suicide run on the Sith transport, crippling it and disconnecting the bridge area from the rest of the vessel. Isen managed to avoid serious injury, but Azard was pinned to his chair. Isen used the Quarren's lightsaber to free him, and smashed one of the vessel's windows with the Force, allowing them to escape. This act surprised Azard, but Isen explained that they were both part of the One Sith and that it was what Krayt would have wanted him to do. The two Sith then swam through the hole Isen had created, escaping the wreckage. The Leviathan they had unleashed upon the Mon Calamari was defeated by the devilsquid, who dragged the beast into the [[Devil's Crevasse]].<ref name="leg33" />

===Poisoning Dac===
{{Quote|What of the other species, Lord Wyyrlok? The Quarren have been allies and the other species, largely neutral.''"<br />"''No one is neutral. They will share the fate of the Mon Calamari. The Quarren's "help" has been nothing. Allow them to flee, but offer them no aid. This is Lord Krayt's will.|Azard and Darth Wyyrlok|<ref name="leg47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>}}
Darth Azard and Isen continued to oversee the Sith Imperial occupation of Dac. The pair were contacted by Lord Wyyrlok, the [[voice]] of Darth Krayt, who announced that it was time to finish Krayt's order to exterminate the Mon Calamari species. Wyyrlok ordered Isen to execute the [[Final Protocol]], a plan that saw the oceans of the Mon Calamari homeworld Dac poisoned and all of the inhabitants executed within one week. Azard questioned Wyyrlok on the fate of the Quarren and other species on Dac, however, Wyyrlok ordered them to allow the Quarren to leave, but offer them no aid. Isen released the viral spores he had put in place, beginning the poisoning of the planet. Alliance Admiral Gar Stazi responded to the genocide by launching a [[Evacuation of Dac|rescue operation]] that succeeded in saving twenty percent of the planet's population.<ref name="leg47" />

===Napdu===
{{Quote|Moff Yage, signal the bombers to unleash the toxin on Da Soocha, then begin the bombardment of Napdu. Fighters will intercept all craft trying to escape the moon. After the bombardment is complete, dispatch stormtroopers to make certain there are no survivors.|Darth Azard|<ref name="leg48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref>}}
After returning from Dac, Azard and Isen continued their mission of eradicating the Mon Calamari species, leading the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]], which was under the command of Moff [[Rulf Yage]], to [[Napdu]], the fourth moon of [[Da Soocha]]. The moon was home to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]], who the Sith suspected was harboring Mon Calamari refugees.<ref name="leg48" />

From aboard the ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer ''[[War Hammer]]'', Azard and Isen communicated with Atirue via holo, informing him he was charged with giving Mon Calamari refuge on Da Soocha, which the Hutt denied. Cutting the communication, Azard ordered Yage to deploy the strike force's [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] to unleash the same toxin that poisoned Dac upon Da Soocha, before beginning the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] of Napdu. The strikeforce began its assault on the moon, destroying most of the moon's population. After the bombardment was completed, stormtroopers were deployed to ensure there were no survivors on the planet. Considering the mission a great victory, the Sith ordered the recall of their forces.<ref name="leg48" />

===Death===
{{Quote|I will deal with these fools! Release the toxin, Vul Isen!|Darth Azard|<ref name="leg50" />}}
[[File:AzardDeath-Legacy50.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Darth Azard dies at the hands of Wolf Sazen.]]
Following up on their success at Napdu, Azard and Isen moved on to the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], with Isen establishing a laboratory within one of the worlds many sinkholes. They intended to ensure the native [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]] and [[Utai/Legends|Utai]]&mdash;who were providing aid to the Alliance and those wounded during the evacuation of Dac&mdash;were completely wiped out. Isen also had an agent ready to assassinate Admiral Stazi, who was on Utapau with part of his Alliance armada in orbit.<ref name="leg49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref> While Isen prepared his poison for Utapau's population, Jedi&ndash;turned&ndash;bounty hunter [[Cade Skywalker]], the descendant of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and his former Master [[Wolf Sazen]] arrived on Utapau, planning to [[Mission to Utapau (Second Imperial Civil War)|eliminate]] the threat Isen posed to the galaxy.<ref name="leg50" />

Just as Isen announced his toxin was ready, Skywalker and Sazen launched their attack on the two Sith. Engaging both Skywalker and Sazen, Azard ordered Isen to release the toxin on the planet's population; however, Sazen was able to hold Azard off to allow Skywalker to pursue Isen. As Azard dueled the Jedi Master, the Sith Lord felt the call of Lord Darth Krayt&mdash;whom Azard believed to be in stasis due to serious injuries&mdash;through the Force. Using Azard's distraction to his advantage, Sazen killed the Sith Lord with a spinning cut from his lightsaber. Meanwhile, Skywalker was able to stop Isen from unleashing his toxin, killing the Sith scientist in the process.<ref name="leg50" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We may all be One Sith, Isen, but we are not ''equals''. I am, as you say, a ''Darth''. Our loyalty is unquestioning as our wills are unbending.|Darth Azard, to Vul Isen|<ref name="leg33" />}}
[[File:Azard_sneaky.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Darth Azard impales a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] trooper.]]
As a member of the One Sith, Darth Azard considered himself a Sith first and not one of his own species.<ref name="leg22" /> He followed Darth Krayt's commands unquestioningly, believing his Lord's commands were all that a true Sith required. When Azard was working with Sith scientist Vul Isen, tension developed between the two as Azard believed Isen's inquisitive nature was contradictory to the ways of a true Sith, and displayed contempt for any member of the One Sith that was not a Darth. As a result of this view, Azard was surprised when Isen saved him in the wreckage of their shuttle.<ref name="leg33" /> Azard also demonstrated his ignorance of Sith lore and history, having little knowledge of the Leviathan.<ref name="leg32" /> While on the planet Utapau, Azard realized Isen was now in command of their mission, much to the Sith Lord's disdain.<ref name="leg49" />

Azard was a Quarren with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and like most members of the Order, his face and body were fully covered in red and black [[Sith tattoo]]s.<ref name="leg20" /> Darth Azard studied the history of Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and held many of the same philosophies particularly in his military command style.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> He was aggressive and short-tempered, executing subordinates instantly for failure. He was feared by those under his command; Admiral Dru Valan chose suicide over facing the Sith Lord following his failure.<ref name="leg21" /> He was also arrogant, believing the Imperial Knight Treis Sinde to be beneath his abilities.<ref name="leg22" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|I sensed a disturbance in the Force and tracked it here. It's coming from my shuttle.|Darth Azard, sensing the attempt to steal his shuttle|<ref name="leg22" />}}
[[File:AzardProtectionBubble.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Darth Azard protects himself after his duel with Treis Sinde.]]
Darth Azard was a skilled wielder of the double-bladed lightsaber in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], using an unusual [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved hilt]]<ref name="leg20" /> similar to that of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="TNEGtWaT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> He also showed his skill in using his lightsaber with only a single blade during his duel with [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]]. Despite Sinde being a [[Master]] in the Imperial Knights, he was not able to defeat Azard and was saved by an explosion set off by the Rogues.<ref name="leg20" />

Apart from his skill with lightsaber, Azard was a proficient wielder of the Force. He was capable of telekinetic uses of the Force such as Force Choke,<ref name="leg20" /> and like many of the One Sith,<ref name="leg1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref><ref name="leg13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref><ref name="leg19">[[Legacy (2006) 19|''Legacy'' (2006) 19]]</ref> was proficient in the use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Darth Azard was also able to sense disturbances in the Force and track them back to their source,<ref name="leg22" /> as well as invoking the Force to awaken a Sith Leviathan with the help of Vul Isen.<ref name="leg32" /> Defensively, Azard was able to protect himself from damage by projecting a shield of Force energy around himself.<ref name="leg22" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Darth Azard was created by writer [[John Ostrander]], and first appeared in the twentieth issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' series, [[Legacy (2006) 20|''Indomitable, Part 1'']], in [[February]] [[2008]].<ref name="leg20" /> He later appeared in a subsequent issue, [[Legacy (2006) 22|''The Wrath of the Dragon'']],<ref name="leg22" /> and was one of the antagonists of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc in [[2009]].<ref name="leg32" /><ref name="leg33" /> Azard reappeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 47|47th]]<ref name="leg47" /> and [[Legacy (2006) 48|48th]] issues of the series in [[2010]], continuing his ongoing story of carrying out the eradication of the Mon Calamari species.<ref name="leg48" /> In ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' released in 2009, a picture of Azard was included among images of other One Sith Darths.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Lord Azard is the third Quarren Sith Lord portrayed in ''Star Wars: Legacy'' after [[Darth Maleval]]<ref name="leg4">[[Legacy (2006) 4|''Legacy'' (2006) 4]]</ref> and an [[unidentified Quarren Sith]].<ref name="leg1" />
